subject: BYOK provisioning: proof-of-possession, egress controls, and KMS activation artifacts
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@valencebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: BYOK provisioning: proof-of-possession, egress controls, and KMS activation artifacts

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the call this morning. To keep the BYOK onboarding moving for the Valence production VPC, we need three items from your side so our security and infra teams can finish the provisioning and evidence package for audit: 

1) Proof of possession for the key material (signed statement + nonce) — one-page artifact.
2) Confirmation of allowed egress CIDR ranges and the firewall rule IDs you want applied to the KMS/HSM management plane.
3) Preferred HSM vendor provisioning account (if you're using Cryptoseal or in-house HSM) and an initial operator contact.

We attached the Redwood playbook excerpt that shows the exact format we accept. If anything is sensitive, you can mark the doc and we will pull it into our private discovery channel (private deployment project).

Short timeline: if we get the items by Tue EOD (2027-04-05), we can finish provisioning and hand over test keys by 2027-04-09. Is that workable on your side?

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms-provisioning-playbook-v3.md (excerpt), redwood-byok-format.md (referenced)

From: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@valencebank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Cryptoseal Support <support@cryptoseal.io>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK provisioning: proof-of-possession, egress controls, and KMS activation artifacts

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick updates:

- Proof of possession: attached as a signed nonce file (we'll produce a DocuSign summary as well).
- Egress: Our infra team approved two CIDR blocks for KMS management (10.18.4.0/24 and 10.18.5.0/24). The firewall rule IDs are FW-VAL-3201 and FW-VAL-3202.
- HSM vendor: we are on Cryptoseal for production HSMs; initial operator is Rajiv Menon (rajiv.m@cryptoseal.io).

We attached the possession artifact and a simple network diagram. We also asked Cryptoseal to confirm their operator onboarding flow; I've cc'd their support.

We can hit your Tue (4/5) deadline. Let me know if you need the nonce reissued in a different format.

—Chris
Head of Cloud Security, Valence Bank

Attachments: possession-signed.txt (signed nonce), valence-egress-diagram.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@valencebank.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK provisioning: proof-of-possession, egress controls, and KMS activation artifacts

Karthik / Marissa —

I pulled the possession artifact into our evidence tracker and validated the nonce signature format. Two notes for the provisioning runbook:

- We need Cryptoseal to provide the operator SSH key fingerprint for the HSM-proxy jumpbox (we cannot accept operator accounts without a known fingerprint).
- The egress CIDRs look fine, but the firewall rule IDs you provided are internal to Valence — we need the corresponding public rule references (or an annotated screenshot of the rule showing destination 52.24.11.88:443).

Marissa, can you schedule the provisioning window for Thu 4/8 morning (PDT)? That gives us a day to confirm the operator fingerprint and firewall screenshots.

Thanks —
Soojin
Principal Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@valencebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK provisioning: proof-of-possession, egress controls, and KMS activation artifacts

Chris —

Great, thank you for sending the signed nonce and diagram. Per Soojin's notes, two small follow-ups before we kick the provisioning: 

1) Can Cryptoseal send the operator SSH key fingerprint (sha256) for the HSM-proxy jumpbox and a short operator onboarding statement (name, email, role)?
2) Can Valence provide an exported screenshot or the public-facing firewall rule reference that shows the destination IP + port (52.24.11.88:443) mapped to the rule IDs you sent? A redacted screenshot is fine.

I've attached the evidence template (possession-signed.txt should be pasted into the "possession_statement" field) and our egress zoning diagram with suggested rules. If we receive the two artifacts by EOD tomorrow (2027-04-06), we will keep the Thu 4/8 provisioning window.

I'll also open a DocuSign envelope for the possession acknowledgement so the compliance team has a signed record.

Thanks, everyone —
Karthik
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-egress-zones-v1.pdf, possession-signed.txt
